title: Car Fleet
prompt: There are n cars at given miles away from the starting mile 0, traveling to reach the mile target. You are given two integer array position and speed, both of length n. A car can never pass another car ahead of it. A car fleet is a non-empty set of cars driving at the same position and same speed. Return the number of car fleets that will arrive at the destination.
hints: Sort cars by position (descending - start from closest to target). Time to reach target = (target - pos) / speed.
Cars behind catch up if their time is less than the car ahead. If time is greater, they form a new fleet.
Use a stack/monotonic: if current car's time <= top of stack, it joins that fleet. Else, it starts a new fleet.
Process from closest to target. Track increasing times - each increase means a new fleet.
